panels.accion: lunges forward, tiny but furious, barking like crazy
panels.dice: I'll handle this. Everybody stay back!

panels.accion: has already opened the door, tail wagging, happily greeting the delivery guy
panels.dice: Hi!! Come in!! I love you!!

panels.accion: tiny and deflated in the corner, defeated
lying dramatically on the floor, paws in the air, screaming
panels.dice: We've been breached! This is the end of everything!

panels.accion: walks in calmly, huge and powerful, grabs the cardboard package in her mouth effortlessly while everyone watches in silence
panels.dice: I got the package. Sit down. All of you.

caption: Every dog has a job. Only Africa actually does it. Tag the 'Africa' of your house.
